subject: Rolling payment lane proposal + VAT liability split for EU pilot
messages:
From: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@helioshealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: emily.zhao@helioshealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — initial invoice & VAT handling questions

Irene / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move the pilot forward. A couple of billing items before we sign the SOW:  

1) Helios prefers Net-60 for new vendors while we complete vendor onboarding. We can do Net-30 for milestone invoices if Redwood needs faster payment; otherwise we usually pay Net-60 for consumption invoices.
2) For EU VAT, our accounting wants confirmation of liability: will Redwood charge VAT on invoices to our UK entity or do you expect reverse-charge? We operate through Helios Health Ltd (UK) and Helios Health GmbH (DE).
3) Can we request a credit ceiling for the pilot so we don’t exceed an agreed threshold without explicit sign-off?

Attached is our standard vendor VAT declaration to help — happy to fill anything you need.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Helios Health

Attachments: VAT-declaration-Helios.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@helioshealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — initial invoice & VAT handling questions

Hi Daniel — really appreciate the quick follow-up and the VAT doc.

Short answers up front:  
- Payment terms: we can accommodate Net-60 for the consumption portion of the pilot, provided we agree a rolling payment lane / credit ceiling to limit exposure. For milestone or fixed-fee items (setup / delivery), we request Net-30.
- VAT: Redwood generally charges VAT based on the billing entity and country of supply. For B2B EU customers that provide a valid VAT number and allow reverse-charge, we can invoice net and indicate reverse-charge. For UK entities post-Brexit we treat per local guidance — if you can confirm the VAT registration numbers for the UK and DE entities we’ll route accordingly.

Proposed path: I’ve attached a simple payment-lane workbook that shows a credit ceiling (EUR 75k) for the pilot and a rolling lane that would automatically stop consumption billing if the ceiling is hit; we’d continue to process milestone invoices at Net-30. If that looks reasonable we can add the lane to the SOW and move DocuSign.

One ask from finance: when you return the VAT sheet please indicate the billing legal entity for each invoice and whether Helios will accept reverse-charge (and supply a VAT number). That lets us avoid double-VAT in our invoices.

I’ll loop Marissa on the operational details once you confirm.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Proposed-payment-lane.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Emily Zhao <emily@helioshealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — initial invoice & VAT handling questions

Thanks Irene — quick note from accounting: we can provide VAT numbers and accept reverse-charge for the DE entity (Helios Health GmbH). For the UK entity (Helios Health Ltd) we need Redwood to issue invoices with UK VAT until our VAT registration is finalized (expected end of Q3). Can we treat DE invoices as reverse-charge and UK invoices as VAT-applicable for the moment?

Also, the EUR 75k ceiling is fine for the pilot, but can we add a short-term bridge: Helios can agree to an initial escrowed payment equal to the first two invoices (estimated EUR 18k) to speed onboarding, with the remainder billed via the rolling lane? We prefer not to expand total exposure beyond the ceiling.

Emily
Senior Accounting Manager
Helios Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@helioshealth.com>, daniel.ruiz <daniel.ruiz@helioshealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — initial invoice & VAT handling questions

Emily / Daniel — great, sounds workable. A couple of operational clarifications so finance and sales are aligned:  

- Escrow for first two invoices: Redwood can accept an initial prepayment/escrow equal to estimated first-two invoices (EUR 18k). We will apply those funds to the first consumption invoices; any unused balance will be refunded or applied per Helios direction.
- Rolling payment lane: the Proposed-payment-lane has three columns — consumption burn, milestone triggers, and available credit. When available credit <= 0 our billing system will raise an automated hold and notify both teams; we’ll pause consumption billing until additional authorization.
- VAT handling: for the DE entity we will invoice net with reverse-charge if you supply the VAT ID. For the UK entity we will include UK VAT until you confirm a VAT number or other change. We will also include a VAT note in the invoice metadata so your AP system can route correctly.

Next steps I propose: 1) Helios returns the completed VAT sheet with VAT IDs + confirmation on billing entity per invoice, 2) Helios signs the SOW with the payment-lane annex, 3) Redwood configures the rolling lane and enables escrow for the first invoices.

Can Marissa and Aditya confirm operational timing on Redwood’s side? I’m aiming for SOW signature and first invoice issuance the week of May 17.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Zhao <emily@helioshealth.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@helioshealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — initial invoice & VAT handling questions

Folks — operational update from Redwood Finance: 

1) We can add the payment-lane annex to the SOW and set the credit ceiling to EUR 75,000. That will be reflected in the DocuSign SOW we’ll send after signatures.
2) Escrow path: we can receive an initial escrow wire or a restricted card authorization for EUR 18,000 against the Helios billing profile; funds are applied to the first two invoices. Please confirm preferred method.
3) Timing: once we receive the completed VAT-declaration sheet with VAT IDs and preferred billing entity per invoice, we will issue the first milestone invoice (Net-30) for the setup fee and enable rolling billing for consumption (Net-60).
4) Attachments: I’ve attached the final SOW (SOW-Redwood-Helios-v1.pdf) and the combined payment-lane workbook. Please review and return so we can route for signature.

If Helios confirms: (a) DE invoices reverse-charge with VAT ID, (b) UK invoices VAT-applicable until Q3 reg completion, and (c) escrow via ACH/wire, we’ll proceed with May 17 target.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Redwood-Helios-v1.pdf (pdf), Proposed-payment-lane.xlsx (spreadsheet)
